name: Karnataka e-Swathu 2.0 — Form 9 / Form 11A Rural-Urban Fringe Property Verification
department: Revenue Department, GoK / Panchayat Raj & Rural Development
governing_act: Karnataka Land Revenue Act 1964, Section 128 & Karnataka Panchayat Raj Act 1993, Section 213; e-Swathu Scheme Circular RD 42 MNS 2015 dated 14-Apr-2015
required_documents: e-Swathu Form 9 Property Extract (from State Data Centre portal, not older than 3 months)
e-Swathu Form 11A Mutation Registered Copy (if transfer has occurred)
Encumbrance Certificate (EC) from Sub-Registrar Office (minimum 13 years)
Registered Sale Deed or Gift Deed or Will (as applicable)
RTC (Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops) Extract from pahani portal
Mutation Record (MR) copy from Taluk Office
Survey Sketch / Village Map showing property boundaries
BDA/BBMP conversion order (if site is in urban fringe or converted layout)

validation_rules.message: Applicant name on the application does not match the owner name in e-Swathu Form 9 Property Extract. Rural property records frequently have Kannada transliteration variations (e.g., 'Ramesh' vs 'Ramesh S/o Narayana' vs 'Ramesha').
validation_rules.remediation: 1. Obtain a fresh Form 9 extract from the e-Swathu portal. 2. File a Mutation application (MR) at the concerned Taluk Office to correct the owner name. 3. If surname/father's name mismatch, submit a sworn affidavit on Rs. 100 stamp paper attested by a Tahsildar or First Class Magistrate.
validation_rules.reference: Karnataka Land Revenue Manual, Chapter XII, Rule 148

validation_rules.message: e-Swathu Form 11A Mutation Reference Number is missing. For rural-to-urban fringe property transfers, Form 11A mutation is mandatory before BBMP e-Khata issuance.
validation_rules.remediation: Apply for Form 11A mutation at the Gram Panchayat office (GP) where the property is located. After GP approval, the mutation number is auto-synced to the State Data Centre e-Swathu portal within 7 days.

validation_rules.message: Survey number format appears invalid or incomplete. e-Swathu portal requires the full survey number in the format '123/4A' or '123/4' as listed in the RTC extract.
validation_rules.remediation: Verify the survey number from the RTC (Pahani) extract on landrecords.kar.nic.in. Ensure the survey number includes sub-division number if applicable.
validation_rules.reference: Karnataka Survey and Settlement Act 1991, Section 9

validation_rules.message: Ward/Zone claimed on the application does not match the pincode-mapped administrative boundary. For rural-urban fringe properties, the jurisdiction may have shifted from Gram Panchayat to BBMP/CMC.
validation_rules.remediation: Check the latest jurisdiction notification from the BBMP/CMC boundary extension circular. If the property is now within BBMP limits, e-Swathu form must be supplemented with BBMP conversion acknowledgement.
validation_rules.reference: BBMP Restructuring Notification Gazette No. UDD/26/MNJ/2007 dated 16-Jan-2007

validation_rules.message: e-Swathu Form 11A mutation application has exceeded the 30-day Sakala SLA. Gram Panchayat is in default.
validation_rules.remediation: File a Sakala SLA Breach Complaint at sakala.kar.nic.in. The Taluk Panchayat Executive Officer (EO) is the First Appellate Authority for GP service delays.
validation_rules.reference: Karnataka Sakala Services Act 2011 — Schedule I, GP Services

The Panchayat Development Officer (PDO),
Gram Panchayat: [GP_NAME],
Hobli: [HOBLI_NAME], Taluk: [TALUK_NAME],
District: Bengaluru [RURAL/URBAN]

Date: [DATE]

Sub: Application for e-Swathu Form 11A Mutation — Survey No. [SURVEY_NUMBER], [VILLAGE_NAME] Village

Respected PDO,

I, [APPLICANT_NAME], son/daughter of [FATHER_NAME], Aadhaar No. [AADHAAR_LAST4XXXX], residing at [ADDRESS], Bengaluru — [PINCODE], hereby apply for mutation of property in e-Swathu records.

Property Details:
- Survey No.: [SURVEY_NUMBER]
- Village: [VILLAGE_NAME]
- Area: [AREA] Acres / Guntas
- Basis of Transfer: [Sale Deed / Inheritance / Gift Deed]
- Deed Registration No.: [REG_NUMBER] dated [REG_DATE] at SR Office, [SR_OFFICE]

I request you to update the e-Swathu Form 9 / Form 11A records to reflect the ownership transfer at the earliest, within the prescribed Sakala SLA of 30 working days.

Yours faithfully,
[APPLICANT_SIGNATURE]
[APPLICANT_NAME]
Mobile: [MOBILE_NUMBER]
